## Summary
Adit Hardiansyah Surachman is an Indonesian Software Engineer and Network Security Specialist based in Bandung, West Java. He graduated from STMIK Mardira Indonesia with a Bachelor of Computer Science (S1 Teknik Informatika), graduating with honors (IPK 3.62 / 4.00, Sangat Memuaskan). He holds the official Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate (Coursera Verified) and the Indonesian National Professional Certification Agency (BNSP) certification.
